substeps.label: 1/10 Area
substeps.caption: The vacuum station by the atomizer: the Nilfisk 118EXP grounded to the building's ground bar, a grounded steel pail with its lid set on, a 30 lb Class D extinguisher and the sign at the tape.

substeps.label: 1/10 Area
substeps.caption: Sign: COMBUSTIBLE METAL POWDER IN USE. Authorized personnel only. NO water, NO compressed air (vacuum SOP 2.3). Every loose metal object in the zone is bonded or removed.

substeps.label: 2/10 The chamber
substeps.caption: After a run: cold, vented, door open. The powder was already brushed into the container and the container taken off (DAL SOP steps 2-3), so it is not drawn.

substeps.label: 3/10 MiR250 2
substeps.caption: MiR250 2 drives in and parks in front of the station, clear of the hose and the vacuum.

substeps.label: 4/10 Take the wand
substeps.caption: The arm reaches for the wand in our holster: the 2F-85 closes on the flats of our clamp-on fin. Nothing is drilled into the Nilfisk wand.

substeps.label: 4/10 Take the wand
substeps.caption: In onto the fin.

substeps.label: 4/10 Take the wand
substeps.caption: Grip.

substeps.label: 4/10 Take the wand
substeps.caption: Lift: the locating pin comes out of the holster's hole, the collar off the fork.

substeps.label: 4/10 Take the wand
substeps.caption: Out of the fork, towards the arm.

substeps.label: 5/10 Continuity
substeps.caption: To the continuity fixture (ours): the tool tip goes onto the bonded spring pad, spring probes touch each joint, a relay box switches the milliohm meter between them.

substeps.label: 5/10 Continuity
substeps.caption: Down onto the pad.

substeps.label: 5/10 Continuity
substeps.caption: Each joint must read 0.1 ohm or less (the OEM manual, UL 1213 par. 22), or the run stops. Readings shown are illustrative: the lab's crevice tool read open on 2026-08-19.

substeps.label: 5/10 Continuity
substeps.caption: Lift off the pad.

substeps.label: 6/10 Equalize
substeps.caption: Equalization touch: the tool tip on the bonded ground button beside the pad, away from the powder (vacuum SOP 3.1).

substeps.label: 6/10 Equalize
substeps.caption: Touch.

substeps.label: 6/10 Equalize
substeps.caption: Clear.

substeps.label: 6/10 Vacuum on
substeps.caption: Vacuum ON before the tool goes near the powder (SOP 3.2). The SOP's switch is on the motor head: a relay on its supply is ours, to be cleared with Nilfisk and EHS.

substeps.label: 7/10 Into the chamber
substeps.caption: The chamber is drawn see-through so the passes inside can be seen. The arm stays outside: only the wand and its tool go through the door.

substeps.label: 7/10 View port
substeps.caption: Round the inside of the view port (one of the two crevices: DAL 178 SOP, T4 6:51), slowly, the nozzle close to the wall (SOP 3.3-3.4).

substeps.label: 7/10 View port
substeps.caption: Round the inside of the view port (one of the two crevices: DAL 178 SOP, T4 6:51), slowly, the nozzle close to the wall (SOP 3.3-3.4).

substeps.label: 7/10 Sloped floor
substeps.caption: Now the chamber is shown cut open at its middle.

substeps.label: 7/10 Sloped floor
substeps.caption: Down the 45 deg floor towards the outlet, a lane at a time, at about 30 mm/s, the nozzle 11 mm off.

substeps.label: 7/10 Sloped floor
substeps.caption: Down the 45 deg floor towards the outlet, a lane at a time, at about 30 mm/s, the nozzle 11 mm off.

substeps.label: 7/10 Sloped floor
substeps.caption: Back up the next lane. The catch bowl, 290 mm past the door at the floor's foot, is out of the wand's reach with the arm outside: a person vacuums it, and the cone from below.

substeps.label: 7/10 Sloped floor
substeps.caption: Back up the next lane. The catch bowl, 290 mm past the door at the floor's foot, is out of the wand's reach with the arm outside: a person vacuums it, and the cone from below.

substeps.label: 7/10 Corners
substeps.caption: Along the front corner, where the sloped floor meets the front wall.

substeps.label: 7/10 Corners
substeps.caption: Along the front corner, where the sloped floor meets the front wall.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: Out of the chamber and over to our tool rack, the wand upright.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: The crevice tool goes into pocket A from the front: its collar slides between our two slotted plates.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: In.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: The arm pulls the wand straight up off the tool's spigot; the upper plate holds the tool down.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: Over the dust brush in pocket B.

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: Down onto its spigot (a push fit; about 30 N, assumed).

substeps.label: 8/10 Tool change
substeps.caption: Out of the pocket to the front, with the brush.

substeps.label: 9/10 Brush
substeps.caption: The dust brush on the plate: brush-and-capture, the bristles just kissing it while the airflow takes what they lift (SOP 3).

substeps.label: 9/10 Brush
substeps.caption: The dust brush on the plate: brush-and-capture, the bristles just kissing it while the airflow takes what they lift (SOP 3).

substeps.label: 9/10 Brush
substeps.caption: Then the door's sealing face, where its seal lands: along the free edge and the top. The brush cannot meet the 45 deg floor square from the door, so the floor had the crevice tool.

substeps.label: 9/10 Brush
substeps.caption: Then the door's sealing face, where its seal lands: along the free edge and the top. The brush cannot meet the 45 deg floor square from the door, so the floor had the crevice tool.

substeps.label: 10/10 Shut down
substeps.caption: Lift the tool clear of the powder, into clean air.

substeps.label: 10/10 Shut down
substeps.caption: Run-on in clean air for 20 s to clear the bores (SOP 4.1); time-lapse.

substeps.label: 10/10 Shut down
substeps.caption: OFF, then wait at least 60 s for the dust to settle before anything is opened (SOP 4.2); time-lapse.

substeps.label: 10/10 Liner
substeps.caption: Liner check: 25 % at most (SOP 4.3). Sealing the liner (gooseneck, 2-3 turns, ESD tape) and lifting it into the pail stay a person's job.

substeps.label: 10/10 Holster
substeps.caption: The wand goes back in its holster, its tool hanging down, the pin in the hole.

substeps.label: 10/10 Holster
substeps.caption: Into the fork.

substeps.label: 10/10 Holster
substeps.caption: Down onto it.

substeps.label: 10/10 Holster
substeps.caption: Let go and back off. Wiping (dry, then a barely damp 70 % IPA wipe) and the log follow.
